import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/customer_segments.csv')

# Set style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))

# Create subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(16, 12))

# 1. Income distribution by education level
income_edu = df.groupby('Education')['Income'].median().sort_values(ascending=False)
bars1 = axes[0, 0].bar(income_edu.index, income_edu.values, color=sns.color_palette("husl", len(income_edu)))
axes[0, 0].set_title('Median Income by Education Level', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Education Level', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Median Income ($)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
for bar in bars1:
    height = bar.get_height()
    axes[0, 0].text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height + 1000,
                   f'${int(height):,}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9)

# 2. Spending categories comparison
spending_cols = ['MntWines', 'MntFruits', 'MntMeatProducts', 'MntFishProducts', 
                 'MntSweetProducts', 'MntGoldProds']
spending_totals = df[spending_cols].sum()
spending_labels = ['Wines', 'Fruits', 'Meat', 'Fish', 'Sweets', 'Gold']
colors2 = sns.color_palette("Set2", len(spending_labels))
wedges, texts, autotexts = axes[0, 1].pie(spending_totals, labels=spending_labels, colors=colors2,
                                          autopct='%1.1f%%', startangle=90)
axes[0, 1].set_title('Total Spending by Category', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('white')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')

# 3. Purchase channels comparison
purchase_cols = ['NumWebPurchases', 'NumCatalogPurchases', 'NumStorePurchases']
purchase_totals = df[purchase_cols].sum()
channels = ['Web', 'Catalog', 'Store']
x_pos = np.arange(len(channels))
bars3 = axes[1, 0].bar(x_pos, purchase_totals, color=sns.color_palette("viridis", len(channels)))
axes[1, 0].set_title('Total Purchases by Channel', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('Purchase Channel', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Total Number of Purchases', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 0].set_xticks(x_pos)
axes[1, 0].set_xticklabels(channels)
for bar in bars3:
    height = bar.get_height()
    axes[1, 0].text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height + 50,
                   f'{int(height):,}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=10)

# 4. Customer demographics heatmap
age_bins = pd.cut(2024 - df['Year_Birth'], bins=[0, 30, 40, 50, 60, 100], 
                  labels=['<30', '30-40', '40-50', '50-60', '60+'])
income_bins = pd.cut(df['Income'], bins=[0, 30000, 50000, 70000, 90000, 200000], 
                     labels=['<30k', '30-50k', '50-70k', '70-90k', '90k+'])
cross_tab = pd.crosstab(age_bins, income_bins, normalize='all') * 100

im = axes[1, 1].imshow(cross_tab.values, cmap='YlOrRd', aspect='auto')
axes[1, 1].set_title('Customer Distribution by Age and Income (%)', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Income Range', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Age Range', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 1].set_xticks(np.arange(len(cross_tab.columns)))
axes[1, 1].set_yticks(np.arange(len(cross_tab.index)))
axes[1, 1].set_xticklabels(cross_tab.columns)
axes[1, 1].set_yticklabels(cross_tab.index)

# Add text annotations to heatmap
for i in range(len(cross_tab.index)):
    for j in range(len(cross_tab.columns)):
        text = axes[1, 1].text(j, i, f'{cross_tab.iloc[i, j]:.1f}%',
                              ha="center", va="center", color="black", fontsize=9)

# Add colorbar for heatmap
cbar = plt.colorbar(im, ax=axes[1, 1], fraction=0.046, pad=0.04)
cbar.set_label('Percentage (%)', fontsize=10)

# Adjust layout and save
plt.suptitle('Customer Segmentation Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
plt.close()
